# Archirodon Office Building

> This three-storey office building stands in Dubai Investments Park, the mixed industrial, commercial and residential district in southern Dubai. It provides open-plan and cellular office floors, meeting rooms and support accommodation for the regional base of an international marine, energy and infrastructure engineering group. Dubai Investments Park has its own road network and utilities and lies close to Jebel Ali, Expo City and Al Maktoum International Airport.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Investments Park, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This new office for Archirodon, the international marine, energy and infrastructure contractor, is located in Dubai Investments Park. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the office, with Innov8 Group as consultant. The project reflects MENASCO's experience in delivering building services for corporate headquarters and regional offices of major engineering and construction groups in the UAE.
